opportunity.name: Beginner fitness e-book series (KDP)
opportunity.target_customer: Beginners starting a home fitness routine
opportunity.problem: Beginners are overwhelmed by long, technical fitness books and abandon routines early.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Short, structured 7-day starter guides with simple daily actions.

facts_from_evidence.claim: KDP pays a 70% royalty on e-books priced between $2.99 and $9.99, before delivery costs.
KDP charges no upfront listing fee to publish an e-book.
The owner already has a working KDP publishing workflow, so no new tooling is needed to produce a short guide.
KDP's 70% royalty band for mid-priced e-books is the main reason short guides can be viable at low sales volume.
Gumroad charges a flat 10% fee on each sale.

market_research.customer_segment: Beginners starting a home fitness routine

demand_indicators.note: Stages: none < general_interest < active_problem_awareness < purchase_consideration < verified_transactions. Search volume, views and likes can justify at most 'general_interest' (§10.3, §18.3).
